name: Hallowed Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the priest trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText:
As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings... dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... but only if da spirits agree.

Go now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.
narrative.requestItemsText: So ya made it... good good! Da spirits tol' me you be comin' to see Ken'jai soon enough. Let me be one o' da first to welcome ya to da Valley of Trials. Dis place not be your home fer long, but while it is, why dontcha make da best o' it.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Hallowed Tablet
quests.objectiveText: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
